faq.q: What is the origin of Ulvi?
faq.a: Ulvi is associated with Arabic. Ulvi is the Azerbaijani form of Arabic عُلْوِيّ (ʿUlwī), meaning 'exalted, sublime'.
Yes — the underlying form عُلْوِي is Arabic.
Ulvi can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Ulvi should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿUlwī is not a Quranic personal name.
